projects.title: ChunkFetch: A Range-Request Proxy with Composable Byte Serving
projects.pitch: Build an HTTP caching proxy that serves large files by composing responses from cached chunks, in-flight fetches, and new origin fetches — aligning origin range requests to fixed on-disk chunk boundaries instead of naive slicing.
you_will_learn: Range request validation (ETag, If-Range, size, 206 correctness)
Chunk-aligned caching and deduplication of in-flight fetches
Reducing p99 TTFB and origin traffic through request coalescing
milestones: Proxy that forwards range requests and caches full objects
Split objects into fixed-size on-disk chunks and serve partial 206 responses from cache
Coalesce concurrent requests for the same byte range into one origin fetch
Add ETag/If-Range revalidation and measure TTFB and origin-traffic reduction under load

projects.title: RefQuorum: Per-Reference Serialized Git Write Server
projects.pitch: Implement a minimal Git-like server that serializes writes per-reference instead of with a repo-wide lock, plus a read path backed by object storage so reads scale independently from writes.
you_will_learn: Lock granularity and write throughput trade-offs
Quorum serialization and consistency under concurrent writers
Read/write path separation with object storage as a virtual replica
milestones: Model refs and objects with a repo-wide write lock baseline
Benchmark write throughput; migrate to per-ref serialization
Add stateless read replicas served from object storage
Measure 3-4x write throughput gain and verify read-after-write consistency semantics

projects.title: TierCache: Adaptive KV-Cache Storage Scheduler
projects.pitch: Build a multi-tier cache engine that treats retrieval as aggregate-bandwidth scheduling across RAM, NVMe, and a remote store — batching reads, deferring writes, and pulling chunks per-tier as bandwidth frees up.
you_will_learn: Backpressure and bandwidth-aware scheduling across storage tiers
Building a performance model to justify dynamic vs static tier splits
milestones: Simulate a workload of prefix chunk reads/writes with latency per tier
Implement batched reads and deferred write-behind
Add per-tier pull scheduling: each tier fetches next unread chunks when idle
Compare throughput/TTFT against a static split baseline and plot the performance model

projects.title: BlastRadius: Cross-Repo Symbol Reference Mapper
projects.pitch: Build a tool that parses a library's public API and scans consumer repositories to find every symbol reference, so you can estimate the blast radius of removing or changing an API before you ship it.
you_will_learn: Building and querying a dependency/reference graph
Release risk scoring from real usage evidence
milestones: Parse a target library and extract its exported symbols
Index symbol references across a set of consumer repos into a graph
Query 'what breaks if I remove X' and rank affected repos
Add a report showing blast radius per proposed change

projects.title: GeoVault: Region-Fenced Key Management with Hybrid HPKE
projects.pitch: Build a key manager that only unwraps private keys inside designated regions, using regional symmetric root keys that derive hybrid post-quantum (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) HPKE key pairs, with fail-closed behavior.
you_will_learn: Hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation in HPKE
Fail-closed security design and TPM-backed provisioning
milestones: Implement an HPKE wrap/unwrap flow with X25519
Add ML-KEM-768 to make the KEM hybrid and verify interop
Build the region/epoch key hierarchy and enforce region-gated unwrap
Simulate a missing regional key and verify fail-closed behavior
